name: Aegiochusmon
main_effect:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Decode ([Aegiomon])＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 [Aegiomon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[When Digivolving] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, this Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and +3000 DP until your opponent's turn ends. Then, this Digimon may attack.
